about_the_game:
Dark forces threaten the land, and only you can stand between them and the fall of Pine Valley. As Commander, it’s your duty to rally your troops and lead your army through ever-changing terrain and harsh weather conditions.

Command or fight — the choice is yours.
Switch seamlessly between a top-down tactical view to direct your army, or jump into the fray yourself in third-person to fight alongside your soldiers. Each battlefield offers new challenges and opportunities to test your strategy and skill.

Build. Adapt. Survive.
Grow your forces, unlock new units and abilities, and shape the flow of each battle. Will you lead from above with precision, or charge into the chaos to inspire your troops firsthand?

The fate of Pine Valley rests in your hands.
